scope: Read-only review of original-derived aligned GLBs, all eight complete full PNGs, sources and plans. Only this report written. No rendering, Blender, Tripo, decimation or geometry change performed.

comparison_choice.confidence: moderate; source fidelity and structural rhythm preference, not assembly acceptance
source_fidelity: A-MV keeps the tall, slender tower impression and three vertically separated square openings much better than A single-image. The source A image shows three openings on each of the visible tower faces; single-image A overall loses much of that rhythm, especially the nearest/right tower with only one obvious opening on the shown face.

A-MV has a more consistent four-tower spacing against the working plan: supplied mid-anchor residuals about 0.31/0.57 m versus A about 1.57/1.54 m. These are approximate identified center projections, not a full-footprint fit proof.

Both candidates preserve four towers, straight western run and northern return, crenellated open flat tower tops, corbels, base rings, slit openings and the overall source construction language. Neither is a precise reproduction of every source masonry/opening detail.
comparison_choice.roughness_and_detail: Both show softened/uneven stone and crenellation edges in the original 2M texture preview. A-MV has more conspicuous weather/crack-like markings and warped opening edges; A can look slightly cleaner at close range but has weaker source proportions/opening fidelity. No PBR material roughness conclusion can be drawn from Workbench TEXTURE proofs.
comparison_choice.tower_crest: Both retain open, paved tower platforms and crenellated parapets with projecting corbels. A-MV better preserves the tall source silhouette. Some crenels and corbels are irregular/rounded; neither is certified mechanically exact.

view_findings.A-overall.png: Four towers present; lower/stockier than source and A-MV; lost/uneven opening counts on visible faces. Northern return present.
view_findings.A-MV-overall.png: Four taller towers, more consistent three-opening vertical rhythm, stronger source resemblance. Original generative waviness remains.
view_findings.A-wall_crest.png: Corbel line, walkway and tower parapet visible; stone edges and crenellation joins softened/irregular. This is an internal A wall-to-tower detail, not the A/B assembly join.
view_findings.A-MV-wall_crest.png: Corbel line and open platform retained, with uneven edges and crack-like markings. This is an internal A-MV wall-to-tower detail, not the A-MV/B assembly join.
view_findings.A-B-C-assembly_top.png: Eight distinct tower discs visible; smaller north court and larger south court retained. C crosses at approximately the second northern tower pair. Near joins appear in contact in plan; no watertightness proof.
view_findings.A-B-C-assembly_oblique.png: All eight towers distinguishable. C is visibly lower than enclosing walls. A side has lower-looking crest/tower silhouette than B; end-junction crest continuity remains visibly uneven.
view_findings.A-MV-B-C-assembly_top.png: Eight towers; straighter/more regular western four-tower line than A. North return is visibly skewed relative to B tower contact, with a projecting tip at the north-east connection. South contact appears overlapping in plan.
view_findings.A-MV-B-C-assembly_oblique.png: Eight towers; A-MV closer to B tower height and stronger source silhouette. North/south wall joins still show changed crest levels/angles and require local contact measurements. C low silhouette is clear, while roof ends disappear into inner tower/wall geometry.

fit_assessment.eight_towers: PASS_visual_count_only: 4 western + 4 eastern, no duplicate end tower required in either assembly.
fit_assessment.footprint: QUALIFIED: overall intended asymmetric envelope is recognizable; B mid-tower center residuals about 3.28 and 2.39 m remain uncorrected. A-MV improves western spacing but cannot correct B with a uniform transform.
fit_assessment.seams: NOT_ACCEPTED: apparent contact in top projection is insufficient. The north A-MV return has a visible skewed/projecting terminal at B contact; both candidates show crest/angle changes at end joins. No claim that all seam gaps are closed or surfaces matched.
fit_assessment.wall_crest_1_5m_gate: NOT_PROVEN: provided object heights A16.70/B18.45/A-MV19.16 m yield bounding-height differences 1.75 m (A-B) and 0.71 m (A-MV-B), but these are not measurements of corresponding crest surfaces at either join. A/B difference is an additional concern. Dedicated end-join samples/projection measurements are required for the <=1.5 m gate. Neither wall_crest PNG depicts an A/B end seam.
fit_assessment.C_low_vs_outer_walls: PASS_visual_relative_height_only: C is clearly below the wall crests in both oblique assemblies (supplied C bound about12.02 m). Fit-plan ~24/~13 labels are concept values, not validation of these aligned originals.
fit_assessment.C_roof_contacts: NOT_ACCEPTED: roof ends meet/disappear into the inward faces of the second northern tower pair. Top/oblique images do not establish clean roof-to-wall junctions, absence of penetration, exact side contact or hidden underside continuity. Treat C as optional/unaccepted until local contact proof; do not certify a clean joined assembly.
fit_assessment.visible_open_gap: No large unambiguous through-gap is evident in these eight proofs. The skewed north terminal, crest steps and embedded C endpoints prevent a seam pass; absence of an obvious background strip is not geometric closure proof.

scale_warning.meaning: Commissioned working exterior-envelope scale only. It is not the historical 66.4 m tower-center dimension and is not the approximately77 m historical exterior envelope.
scale_warning.transforms: Uniform root scale/rotation/translation preserve each source original geometry proportion. BIN, mesh and image JSON equality verified; candidates are aligned copies, not corrected meshes.
